/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.title: Exhibition Stand Design Abu Dhabi | Layout, 3D Brief & Build | FANN
/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.description: Plan an Abu Dhabi exhibition stand around your products, meetings and venue allocation. Compare layout choices, see completed FANN stands and send a scoped design brief.
/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.heading: Exhibition stand design in Abu Dhabi
/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.intro: Start with what your stand needs to do, not only how it should look. FANN develops exhibition stand design and build proposals for Abu Dhabi exhibitors, with a Dubai office and an in-house joinery workshop in Umm Al Quwain. Your show, stand allocation, products and opening date shape the design and agreed build scope.
/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.heroAlt: Completed TREVOS exhibition stand at Light Middle East in Dubai, 2023
/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.heroCaption: Completed FANN stand: TREVOS, Light Middle East, Dubai, 2023. Shown as a design reference, not an Abu Dhabi project.

sections.heading: Choose the layout around your visitor journey
sections.text: A product-led stand needs clear sightlines and room for demonstrations. A meeting-led stand needs conversation space without blocking the entrance. A mixed stand must balance both. Send the products, display dimensions, expected activities and meeting needs so the layout can be developed around them.
items: Arrival: decide what visitors should understand from the aisle before entering.
Demonstration: allow space for the actual product, staff and visitors. Record any power, water, data or ventilation needs.
Meetings: choose open conversation points or more private seating according to the brief.
Storage and reception: include these in the floor plan rather than leaving them until the final design.

sections.heading: Corner, island or one open side?
sections.text: The organiser allocation determines the available open sides and neighbouring stands. A corner can offer two approach routes; an island needs a coherent view from several directions. A stand with one open side needs a clear entry and a layout that does not hide the main offer behind reception or storage. These are design choices, not promises of higher footfall or more leads.

sections.heading: From concept to an agreed build scope
sections.text: A 3D concept communicates the layout and appearance. It is not a structural approval, a material specification or a production instruction on its own. Before fabrication, agree drawings, dimensions, materials, finishes, graphics and the responsibilities for services, submissions and site access. Design-only and design-and-build briefs should say which deliverables are required.
items: Brief: show, venue, hall, stand dimensions, open sides, brand assets and visitor objectives.
Concept: review circulation, product displays, meeting areas, storage and brand visibility together.
Scope: identify design work, fabrication, graphics, transport, installation and any dismantling separately.
Release: agree the design and production information before committing to materials or site works.

sections.heading: Planning for ADNEC or another Abu Dhabi venue
sections.text: Send the current show exhibitor manual and your allocated hall or floor plan. Confirm the organiser submission dates, build-up access and the services ordered through the venue. Complex structures and specialist services can need separate review or approved providers. The requirements depend on your actual show and design; a prior event manual is not a universal deadline. FANN is independent, not the organiser or an appointed ADNEC official contractor.

sections.heading: Compare a design proposal before choosing a contractor
sections.text: Compare like for like: drawing deliverables, materials and finish samples, graphics, utilities, approval responsibilities, installation access and exclusions. A lower headline price may cover a different scope. Ask who owns each submission and which changes need a revised quote. No standard price, approval outcome or fixed production duration is assumed here.

proof.name: TREVOS - Light Middle East
proof.text: Completed stand photograph with an overhead identity feature, product displays and visitor-facing space. Use it to discuss the relationship between brand visibility and the floor layout.

proof.name: Geven - Aircraft Interiors Middle East
proof.text: Completed aircraft-interiors exhibition stand reference. Share your own product dimensions and access needs rather than copying another exhibitor's layout.

/exhibition-stand-design-abu-dhabi.proofNote: These are completed Dubai stands from FANN's portfolio, used as design references for an Abu Dhabi brief. They do not establish an Abu Dhabi venue appointment, a material grade, structural capacity or measured sales result.

faqs.question: What does an exhibition stand design brief need?
faqs.answer: Send the show and venue, allocated stand dimensions and open sides, floor plan, brand assets, product sizes, demonstration and meeting needs, storage requirements and your submission and opening dates. Add the current exhibitor manual if you have it.

faqs.question: Can I ask for design without assuming a full turnkey build?
faqs.answer: State whether your brief is for design deliverables or design and build. The proposal should list the drawings, visuals and any production, transport, installation or dismantling being quoted. Do not assume every item is included.

faqs.question: How do I choose between a product-led and meeting-led stand?
faqs.answer: Prioritise the activity visitors need to complete. Product demonstrations need suitable display and circulation space; meetings need seating and the right level of privacy. A mixed brief should identify the priority when space is limited.

faqs.question: Does a 3D design mean the stand is approved for ADNEC?
faqs.answer: No. A concept visual is not an organiser or structural approval. Review the current show manual, the actual design and any required technical submissions with the responsible parties before production and installation.

faqs.question: Where are the office and workshop?
faqs.answer: FANN's office is in Dubai and its in-house joinery workshop is in Umm Al Quwain. Abu Dhabi exhibition work is planned around the specific show, design and agreed site scope.

faqs.question: How much does exhibition stand design and build cost?
faqs.answer: There is no single price for every stand. Dimensions, layout, materials, graphics, specialist services, venue requirements, installation and the scope being quoted affect the total. Send your allocation and brief for an itemised proposal.

faqs.question: Can the design be changed after it is agreed?
faqs.answer: Ask before changing the approved design. Materials, graphics, submissions or production may already be committed. Confirm any change in scope, cost and schedule before work continues.

/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.title: Medical Centre Fit-Out Company Dubai | Operator Brief & Scope | FANN
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.description: Planning a medical centre or polyclinic in Dubai? Build a room-by-room fit-out brief, compare scope and approval responsibilities, and see healthcare projects in the FANN portfolio.
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.heading: Medical centre fit-out in Dubai
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.subheading: Plan a multi-room healthcare fit-out around the service brief, room schedule and responsibilities before pricing.
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.intro: A medical centre is more than a collection of consulting rooms. Reception, patient routes, staff areas and room services need to work together. FANN is a Dubai design and build company with an in-house joinery workshop in Umm Al Quwain. Start your medical-centre fit-out enquiry with the planned services, site information and room schedule so the proposed work can be defined and priced. Clinical planning and licensing decisions remain with the operator and the appointed qualified specialists.
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.heroAlt: Aspris Clinic City Walk reception photograph from the FANN portfolio
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.heroCaption: Aspris Clinic - City Walk: a healthcare project in the FANN portfolio. The photograph is a reception reference, not evidence of regulatory approval or the scope of every trade.
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.proofHeading: Healthcare projects in the FANN portfolio
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.proposalHeading: Request a scoped medical-centre fit-out proposal
/medical-centre-fit-out-dubai.proposalText: Share the location, available drawings, planned services, room list and target opening date. Identify the operator, design consultant and any specialist equipment suppliers. Agree the responsibilities and exclusions before work is committed.

sections.heading: Start with the clinical service brief, not a finish palette
sections.text: Define what the centre will provide and who will use it. A polyclinic with several specialities needs a different room schedule from a single-practitioner clinic. The DHA Health Centres guidance describes reception and waiting, consultation areas, staff and support areas, with specialist areas depending on the service plan. Use that framework with your healthcare design consultant; it is not a ready-made layout for every unit.
items: List the planned specialities, consultation and treatment functions, and expected staff needs.
Identify shared rooms and rooms that need dedicated equipment or services.
Record accessibility, privacy and patient movement needs in the brief.
Keep clinical requirements separate from optional decorative finishes.

sections.heading: Build a room-by-room scope before comparing quotes
sections.text: A room schedule connects the operator brief to the fit-out scope. For each room, record the intended use, approved design information, joinery, finishes, equipment interfaces and services. Compare proposals against the same schedule so a missing item does not look like a saving. Final requirements must follow the applicable design and authority review.
items: Reception and waiting: desk functions, seating layout, storage and wayfinding.
Consultation and treatment rooms: the agreed layout, privacy, cabinetry and equipment interfaces.
Support and staff rooms: the functions and storage required by the operator brief.
Services: show which party designs, supplies, installs, tests and signs off each interface.

sections.heading: Separate fit-out work from specialist equipment
sections.text: Do not assume that a fit-out quotation includes medical equipment, specialist systems or their certification. Provide equipment schedules and supplier drawings where available. Confirm power, data, plumbing, ventilation and other interfaces with the appointed designers and suppliers before setting out partitions or producing cabinetry. Room services are project-specific; a reception photograph does not establish what a treatment room needs.

sections.heading: Check the authority route for the actual location
sections.text: Dubai does not have one interchangeable approval route for every healthcare address. DHA guidance describes healthcare facility design and licensing within its jurisdiction, with Dubai Healthcare City identified as an exception. DHCC publishes a separate engineering fit-out process. Confirm the applicable regulator, landlord requirements and appointed qualified healthcare design consultant for the site. FANN is not presented here as a DHA-prequalified healthcare design consultant, a regulator or a guarantor of approval.
items: Confirm the facility type, location and licensing route with the operator and the relevant authority.
Name the party responsible for healthcare design submissions, landlord approvals and fit-out permits.
Keep current approved drawings and revision history available to the site team.
Treat an opening date as a planning target, not permission to start before approvals.

sections.heading: Plan procurement and handover around agreed responsibilities
sections.text: Agree the design information needed before joinery production, the site access conditions and any dependencies on specialist suppliers. For an occupied centre, discuss whether work can be phased and what operational restrictions apply. The programme must reflect the actual scope and approvals; no fixed duration or uninterrupted operation is promised.
items: Confirm drawing release, material samples and equipment interface information before production.
Record working hours, access, protection and waste arrangements with the building team.
Agree testing, inspections, defects and handover documents by trade.
Keep licensing and permission to operate distinct from construction completion.

sections.heading: Looking for medical centre fit-out in Arabic?
sections.text: Common search terms include تجهيز مركز طبي في دبي and تشطيب عيادات ومراكز طبية في دبي. This page is an English operator brief for medical-centre and polyclinic fit-out enquiries. Send the site details and room schedule to discuss the proposed work.

They are references for discussing interior preferences, not claims of sole design ownership, sole contractor responsibility, measured clinical outcomes or authority approval. The scope proposed for your centre will be confirmed separately.

faqs.question: What is different about a medical-centre fit-out brief?
faqs.answer: A multi-room centre needs a clinical service plan, room schedule and clear responsibilities for shared spaces, services and specialist equipment. Start with those requirements before comparing finishes or headline prices.

faqs.question: What should I send FANN for a medical-centre fit-out enquiry?
faqs.answer: Send the site location, available drawings, planned services, room list, equipment information, current approval status and target opening date. Identify the operator and appointed design consultant so the proposed construction and joinery scope can be defined.

faqs.question: Does this page promise DHA approval?
faqs.answer: No. Approval and licensing depend on the facility, location and applicable authority requirements. The operator should confirm the route and appoint the qualified specialists needed. FANN is not described here as a DHA-prequalified healthcare design consultant or an approval guarantor.

faqs.question: Is Dubai Healthcare City handled in the same way?
faqs.answer: Do not assume so. Dubai Healthcare City publishes its own engineering fit-out process, while DHA healthcare facility guidance identifies DHCC as an exception to its jurisdiction. Confirm the current regulator, building and fit-out requirements for your address.

faqs.question: Are medical equipment and specialist systems included?
faqs.answer: Only if the agreed proposal specifically includes them. Record design, supply, installation, testing and certification responsibilities for equipment and services separately from general fit-out and joinery.

faqs.question: Can I see real healthcare project photographs?
faqs.answer: Yes. This page links to Aspris Clinic - City Walk and Fayy Health Polyclinic in the FANN portfolio, with real project galleries. The photographs are interior references, not proof of sole design or contractor responsibility.

faqs.question: How much does a medical-centre fit-out cost in Dubai?
faqs.answer: There is no single price on this page. Location, room functions, existing condition, equipment interfaces, finishes and the agreed responsibilities affect the scope. Compare itemised proposals against the same drawings and room schedule.

/ar/exhibition-stands-dubai.intro: FANN شركة تصميم وتنفيذ أجنحة معارض، لها مكتب في دبي وورشة نجارة داخلية في أم القيوين. نطور تصميم الجناح ونطاق التصنيع والتركيب بحسب المعرض ومخطط المساحة وموعد الافتتاح. يوضح عرض السعر المواد والرسومات والتركيب وأي أعمال تفكيك متفق عليها، بدلاً من افتراض أن جميع المشاريع تشمل النطاق نفسه.

/ar/exhibition-stands-dubai.proposalText: أرسل اسم المعرض والموقع وأبعاد المساحة والواجهات المفتوحة والموعد المطلوب. أضف مخطط المساحة إذا كان متاحاً. نموذج طلب العرض باللغة الإنجليزية، ويمكن إرفاق المخطط دون تغيير إجراءات إرسال الطلب.

sections.heading: ابدأ بما يحتاج الجناح إلى تحقيقه
sections.text: هل تعرض منتجات، أم تحتاج مساحة لاجتماعات العمل، أم تقدم عروضاً توضيحية؟ يبدأ الجناح المخصص بالمساحة المخصصة لك وبحركة الزوار والأنشطة المطلوبة. حدد أحجام المنتجات واحتياجات العرض والاستقبال والتخزين قبل اعتماد التصميم. يمكن مناقشة الأنظمة المعيارية إذا كان الاستخدام المتكرر مناسباً لموجز المشروع.
items: اسم المعرض والقاعة ورقم المساحة إن توفر.
أبعاد الجناح وعدد الواجهات المفتوحة ومخطط التخصيص.
المنتجات وأبعادها ومتطلبات العروض التوضيحية والخدمات.
هوية العلامة والرسومات واحتياجات الاجتماعات والتخزين.

sections.heading: من مخطط المساحة إلى التسليم
sections.text: نطور توزيع المساحات والتصور البصري، ثم نتفق على المواد والرسومات ونطاق التنفيذ قبل الإنتاج. تراجع الرسومات والخدمات والنقل ومتطلبات تقديم التصميم وفق دليل العارضين الحالي. يدعم التصنيعَ فريقُ الورشة في أم القيوين، ويحدد نطاق التركيب والتسليم بحسب ظروف الدخول إلى الموقع والبرنامج المتفق عليه.
items: الموجز: حدد المساحة والهدف والموعد والمعلومات المتاحة.
التصميم: راجع العرض والاستقبال والاجتماعات وحركة الزوار معاً.
نطاق العمل: اتفق على المواد والتشطيبات والرسومات ومسؤوليات كل طرف.
الإنتاج والتركيب: أكد المعلومات المعتمدة ووقت الدخول وفحوص التسليم.

sections.heading: لا تفترض أن رسوم الموقع والخدمات مشمولة
sections.text: قارن العروض على أساس البنود نفسها. حدد من يتولى تقديم الرسومات ومن يطلب الكهرباء أو التعليق العلوي أو الخدمات الأخرى عند الحاجة. قد تكون الأثاث والشاشات والتخزين والنقل والتفكيك بنوداً منفصلة أو مقدمة من طرف آخر. لا تعد الصورة وحدها دليلاً على قدرة كهربائية أو حمولة إنشائية أو موافقة هندسية.

sections.heading: التخطيط لمعرض في مركز دبي التجاري العالمي أو موقع آخر
sections.text: أرسل دليل العارضين الحالي ومخطط التخصيص ومواعيد تقديم التصميم والدخول إلى الموقع. تختلف المتطلبات بين المعارض والمواقع والتصاميم؛ موعد افتتاح المعرض ليس موعداً تلقائياً للتصنيع أو التركيب. FANN جهة مستقلة وليست منظم المعرض أو مقاولاً رسمياً معيناً من الموقع. لا يتضمن هذا الدليل ضماناً بالموافقة أو سعراً ثابتاً أو مدة تنفيذ موحدة.

sections.heading: ما الذي يحدد سعر جناح المعرض؟
sections.text: تحدد المساحة والتصميم والمواد والرسومات ومتطلبات الخدمات والنقل والتركيب نطاق العرض. لا يوجد سعر موحد منشور هنا. اطلب توضيح البنود المشمولة والمستثناة وتكلفة التغييرات بعد اعتماد التصميم. التصور ثلاثي الأبعاد يوضح الشكل والتوزيع، لكنه لا يحل محل الرسومات والمواصفات والموافقات المطلوبة.

proof.name: TREVOS - Light Middle East
proof.text: تظهر الصورة هوية علوية وعروض منتجات مضاءة واستقبالاً ومساحة للمحادثات. تستخدم كمرجع لتوازن ظهور العلامة مع توزيع المساحة، وليس لتحديد الأحمال أو القدرة الكهربائية.

proof.name: Geven - Aircraft Interiors Middle East
proof.text: تظهر الصورة واجهة تحمل العلامة واستقبالاً مضاءً وعناصر عرض ودرجاً إلى مساحة علوية. وجود مستوى علوي في الصورة لا يعني إمكان نسخه دون مراجعة هندسية ومتطلبات خاصة بالمعرض.

faqs.question: هل تصمم FANN أجنحة المعارض وتصنعها وتركبها في دبي؟
faqs.answer: نعم. نطور التصميم ونطاق التصنيع والتركيب وفق موجز المعرض ومخطط المساحة ومتطلبات الموقع. لنا مكتب في دبي وورشة نجارة داخلية في أم القيوين. يعتمد النطاق النهائي على العرض المتفق عليه.

faqs.question: ما المعلومات المطلوبة للحصول على عرض سعر؟
faqs.answer: أرسل اسم المعرض والموقع وأبعاد الجناح وعدد الواجهات المفتوحة والمخطط والموعد المطلوب. حدد المنتجات والخدمات والرسومات واحتياجات الاجتماعات والتخزين حتى يمكن إعداد نطاق واضح.

faqs.question: هل يشمل العرض الكهرباء والتعليق العلوي ورسوم الموقع؟
faqs.answer: لا تفترض ذلك. يجب تسمية كل خدمة ورسومها ومسؤولية طلبها كبند مشمول أو مستثنى أو مقدم من طرف آخر. تؤكد المتطلبات وفق دليل المعرض الحالي والتصميم الفعلي.

faqs.question: هل التفكيك مشمول بعد المعرض؟
faqs.answer: يكون التفكيك مشمولاً فقط عندما ينص عليه نطاق العرض. اتفق أيضاً على النقل والتخزين أو إعادة الاستخدام إذا كانت مطلوبة.

faqs.question: هل توجد صور لمشاريع معارض حقيقية؟
faqs.answer: نعم. تتضمن هذه الصفحة مراجع TREVOS في Light Middle East بدبي عام 2023 وGeven في Aircraft Interiors Middle East بدبي عام 2025، مع روابط صفحات المشاريع.

faqs.question: هل FANN مقاول رسمي لمركز دبي التجاري العالمي؟
faqs.answer: لا نقدم هذا الادعاء. FANN شركة مستقلة لتصميم وتنفيذ أجنحة المعارض. يجب تأكيد متطلبات المنظم والموقع ومسؤوليات التقديم والخدمات لكل معرض.

faqs.question: هل يمكن إرسال الطلب من هذه الصفحة العربية؟
faqs.answer: نعم. ينتقل زر الطلب إلى نموذج عرض الجناح الحالي باللغة الإنجليزية، مع إمكانية إرفاق المخطط. لا تتغير إجراءات إرسال الطلب أو القياس من هذه الصفحة.

sections.heading: GITEX 2026: confirm the exhibition venue, not only the event name
sections.text: Official sources checked on 12 October 2026 list the exhibition and conferences for 8-11 December at Expo City Dubai, with the venue listing identifying Dubai Exhibition Centre. The separate GITEX Summit is on 7 December at Dubai World Trade Centre. Send the venue, hall and stand allocation on your exhibitor documents. These public event dates are not build-up, submission or dismantling deadlines.

sections.heading: Start with the actual demonstration
sections.text: List what each demo needs to show and what visitors need to do. A screen-led software demonstration, a device display and a staffed hands-on experience need different space and service briefs. Work from the actual equipment and presenter positions, then plan the display, viewing space and queue without blocking entry.
items: Demo equipment: dimensions, weights and operating requirements supplied by the equipment owner.
Display and AV: screen positions, mounting requirements, sound and who supplies or operates each item.
Services: equipment loads, sockets, connectivity and any specialist interfaces to be checked with the relevant suppliers.
Staff and visitors: presenter positions, access, waiting space and nearby meeting areas.

sections.heading: Separate power and data from the joinery scope
sections.text: Identify the equipment, service requirements and responsible supplier before the layout is signed off. Confirm organiser service-order routes and deadlines from the current exhibitor manual. Dedicated internet, Wi-Fi, AV and electrical services should not be assumed to be included in a stand build. A demonstration that depends on connectivity also needs a fallback agreed by your technical team; FANN does not promise network speed or uptime.

sections.heading: Keep meetings and lead capture out of the demo queue
sections.text: Decide whether the stand needs short aisle conversations, seated sales meetings or a more private discussion area. Place reception, storage and equipment access so they do not compete with the main demo. Your team should specify the lead-capture process, devices and privacy requirements. The layout can support this workflow, but it does not guarantee traffic, leads or sales.

sections.heading: Use the current exhibitor manual for production and site access
sections.text: Provide the manual, allocated stand plan and submission or service deadlines. Agree the owners of drawings, approvals, utilities, installation access, on-site support and dismantling. Confirm materials, graphics, equipment interfaces and any specialist structure before production. Do not reuse a previous venue assumption or treat a 3D concept as a structural approval.

sections.heading: Compare a named scope, not a vague package
sections.text: The proposal should identify design deliverables, stand elements, graphics, logistics, installation and any support or dismantling. State separately which services come from the organiser or specialist suppliers. Send your budget range and required dates with the brief; no fixed price, completion duration or approval outcome is assumed.

faqs.question: Are internet, AV and electricity automatically included?
faqs.answer: No. Name each requirement and the responsible supplier in the agreed proposal. Organiser service orders, electrical work, connectivity and AV may have separate requirements and deadlines. No network performance guarantee is assumed.

faqs.question: Can FANN design a stand around live technology demos?
faqs.answer: FANN can develop the layout and build proposal around the demo brief, equipment and visitor workflow. Equipment operation, service requirements and specialist interfaces must be provided and checked with the relevant technical suppliers.

faqs.question: Do you handle all approvals and dismantling?

sections.heading: Big 5 Global 2026: confirm your booked allocation
sections.text: The organiser lists Big 5 Global for 23-26 November 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre. Your booking, hall plan and current exhibitor manual control the usable space, access and submissions. Public show dates are not a build-up or dismantling schedule.
items: Send the stand number, hall, dimensions and open sides shown on your booking.
Identify whether you have a shell scheme to dress or space-only allocation needing a stand build.
Confirm the current manual, service orders and any restrictions before the design is priced.

sections.heading: Design around the product, not a generic booth
sections.text: Building-material samples, sanitary products, coatings and equipment create different display needs. Choose what visitors should see from the aisle and what they should examine at close range. A display plan should leave enough room for product discussion without blocking the visitor route.
items: Samples and finishes: list sample sizes, quantities, mounting method and what can be handled.
Product displays: give dimensions, weights, support points and delivery packaging for every item.
Working demonstrations: identify power, water, drainage, data or any moving parts that need a separate check.
Buyer meetings: state how many people need to sit, where drawings or catalogues are used, and what needs secure storage.

sections.heading: Samples, support and utilities need an agreed responsibility
sections.text: A photograph cannot establish a shelf load, floor capacity, fixing detail or safe demonstration zone. FANN and the exhibitor should identify who supplies each display, who checks its support and connections, and what the venue or specialist supplier must approve. Do not assume a stand-build quote includes venue power, lifting, plumbing or equipment commissioning.
items: Mark the product supplier, stand contractor and specialist responsibilities on one brief.
Confirm handling, unloading, access and storage for crates and replacement samples.
Keep visitor routes separate from demonstrations or equipment movement where the design needs it.
Agree the documents and checks needed for the actual products and venue.

sections.heading: What to include in a Big 5 stand-build quote
sections.text: Ask for a named scope covering design, fabrication, graphics, agreed lighting, transport, installation and handover checks. Identify furniture, AV, organiser services, specialist equipment, storage and dismantling as included, excluded or supplied by others. Changes after design approval, access dependencies and the payment schedule should be written down. The exhibition date alone does not establish a safe production lead time.

sections.heading: Arabic and international exhibitor briefs
sections.text: A Big 5 brief can include English and Arabic brand artwork, product labels and visitor-facing messages. Supply approved wording and artwork rather than relying on a builder to translate product claims. For overseas teams, name the local product-delivery contact and who can sign off the design and site decisions. Related Arabic search terms include تصميم جناح بيج 5 and تصميم أجنحة المعارض في دبي.
